integrity: Mathematical derivations, explicit normalizations, independent geometry integration, and optional symbolic expansion checks are reproducible in the included code; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: An exact implicit Cheeger equation and sharp flat-arc asymptotic only for Euclidean regular disk triangles of fixed minimum width; no global monotonicity or general-body extremality is claimed. General convex Cheeger characterization is classical. Unindexed equivalent specializations remain possible.
title: Exact Cheeger sets and a sharp flat-arc limit for regular disk triangles
